verdicts.reason: A crams everything into a cramped centre stack, leaving the left and right thirds empty. A loose orange rectangle sits next to it, the presenter line collides with the arrow and the credit line, the text is tiny, the orange tint is lost and the reading order is jumbled. B at least reads left to right as a banner, but the presenter text is wrapped one word per line at an unreadable size. Broken frame-line fragments overlap 'Pygmalion', the arbitrary orange strip splits the layout, and the oversized play-arrow icon competes with the headline.
